title: POST /books echoes the request body instead of the persisted row
evidence: src/server.ts:21 builds the response object from req.body ({ id, title, author, year, isbn }) rather than re-reading the row it inserted; when year/isbn are omitted the response drops them while the DB stores null
suggestion: Return the row read back from the DB (SELECT ... WHERE id = info.lastInsertRowid) for consistency with GET

title: Tests share the persistent on-disk SQLite DB with no per-test reset
evidence: src/database.ts:5 opens ./data/books.db and tests/api.test.ts creates rows without truncating; state accumulates across runs
suggestion: Use an in-memory DB (':memory:') or truncate the books table in beforeEach so tests are hermetic
